overview_description.description:
Patch focuses on building infrastructure for a climate-positive economy, starting with an API for carbon removal. The company makes carbon removal as simple as writing a few lines of code. Build sustainable products with ease and put your climate goals on autopilot.

It was founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
